name: Joe Biden
stanceSummary: Joe Biden served as the 46th U.S. President (2021–2025). Track AIPAC congressional totals do not apply. Official records show continued U.S. military support for Israel alongside repeated diplomatic pushes for a Gaza ceasefire, hostage release, and expanded humanitarian aid.

timeline.event: Biden outlined a three-phase Gaza ceasefire and hostage-release framework, including Israeli withdrawal from populated areas and a surge of humanitarian assistance.
Biden announced Israel and Hamas had reached a ceasefire and hostage-release deal based on the framework he proposed in May 2024.
